items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to make a laver (basin) of brass with a brass foot for washing purposes

items.quote: thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar
items.claim: The laver shall be placed between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar
items.place: between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar

items.claim: Water shall be placed in the laver
